transcript.text: w/m finally died after 12 yrs, whats the best one to buy under £400? family of 5

Buying a washing machine for a family of five on a £400 budget is very doable. At that price point, you will get a reliable 9kg or 10kg front-loader from a major brand (Bosch/Siemens, Miele, AEG, Hoover, Beko, or Samsung). For a large household, capacity and reliability are key. Top recommendations under £400:
• Hoover H-Wash 300/400 series (8kg or 9kg): Good basic reliability, simple to use, and frequently discounted under £400.
• Bosch Serie 2 or 4 (8kg or 9kg): Slightly more expensive but known for longevity. Avoid the very entry-level models if possible, as they lack some efficiency features. Key things to look for:
1. Capacity: Aim for at least 9kg. An 8kg machine will struggle with duvet covers and large loads for five people.
2. 3. Energy Rating: Look for A or B rating to save on running costs over the next decade. Since your old one died after 12 years, it was well-used! When installing the new one, ensure it's level and the drain hose isn't kinked. Would you like advice on installation or removing the old machine?
